subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Several religious organizations are involved in the effort to __**facilitate**__ the settlement of the immigrants arriving in the area.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"facilitate"** means to make an action or process easy or easier. (सुविधाजनक बनाना)

 
 
• **Example: **The new software will **facilitate** the scheduling of appointments.
 
 
 
• **"Ease"** refers to making something less difficult or more comfortable. (सुविधा देना)
 
 
• **Example: **She used humor to **ease** the tension in the room.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'facilitate' **is **'ease'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Ease**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hinder **(बाधा डालना): To make it difficult for something to happen or for someone to do something.

 
 
• **Example:** His interference hindered the progress of the project.
 
 
 
• **Demolish **(ध्वस्त करना): To completely destroy a building, especially in order to use the land for something else.
 
 
• **Example: **The old building was demolished to make way for a new shopping center.
 
 
 
• **Retard **(धीमा करना): To make the development or progress of something slower.
 
 
• **Example:** The lack of funding could retard the development of new technologies.
 
 

33:Tb93,
The correct answer is Option 2</
